title: Empirical Approximation of $L_p$ Norms
summary: We study empirical $L_p$ moments of a random vector $\pmb\varphi$ based on its i.i.d.\ copies $\pmb\varphi^1,\ldots,\pmb\varphi^m$, that is, $\frac1m\sum_{j=1}^m |\langle \pmb\varphi^j,y\rangle|^p$. Our main result is a new estimate for the expected uniform deviation \[ \mathbb{E}\sup_{y\in D}\biggl| \frac1m\sum_{j=1}^m |\langle \pmb\varphi^j,y\rangle|^p -\mathbb{E}|\langle \pmb\varphi,y\rangle|^p \biggr| \] over an arbitrary index set $D$.
